title: Japanese Kiku Ningyo Floral Doll Display, c. 1930s Japan Snapshot Photo
description: A striking snapshot capturing a traditional Japanese chrysanthemum doll (Kiku Ningyo) diorama display, likely during an autumn floral festival in the 1930s. The figures represent historical or theatrical characters with realistic wax or papier-mâché heads and hands, while their elaborate garments are painstakingly constructed using living chrysanthemum blossoms. A painted landscape backdrop of pine trees and mountains frames the scene alongside an explanatory Japanese sign, viewed by spectators standing on the right.
